info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Healthcare Appointments Book-v4-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Booking API allows users to facilitate the booking of medical appointments efficiently. This API enables healthcare providers and patients to schedule, manage, and confirm appointments through a streamlined process. Common consumers include healthcare organizations, patient management systems, and telehealth platforms. Users can leverage this API to reduce appointment booking time, enhance patient access, and improve overall healthcare service delivery.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to schedule a new appointment. Please provide the required details to successfully book your appointment.

requestBody.description: This endpoint allows users to book an appointment by providing necessary details in the request body.

200.description: The appointment has been successfully booked.
